<ic>The senate issues an invitation to The Grendel to discuss terms by which the war between The Grendel and the Empire can cease, with the proposer and seconder as representatives of the Empire. A representative of The Grendel is invited to Anvil to discuss terms under the usual terms of diplomatic visitors to Anvil<br><br><i>Proposed by Therunin, seconded by Weirwater.</i></ic> 


===Overview===
* This motion follows on from the Senate refusing the Grendel [http://www.profounddecisions.co.uk/empire-wiki/Accept_Grendel_peace_treaty peace treaty] at the Summer Solstice of 379YE
* Passed

===Date===
* Autumn 379YE.

===Campaign Outcome===
* The civil service, as of yet, has received no response from the Grendel.
